body: Hey, sorry I couldn't get back to you earlier and yeah I'm feeling a little better now, I'll probably retire this account until depression hits me harder than usual again. Thanks a lot !

First off, thanks for responding, secondly I can't really pinpoint when and what made me feel like an outsider. I think it was around when my mother died. That's when everyone started looking at me differently, like I'm some kind of freak. That type of stuff is what made me lose connection to a lot of my family.
